text:
emily: spotted a suspicious JSON blob in staging logs while triaging a flaky job. looks like a service account payload: `"type": "service_account"` and `"private_key_id"` present. s3://staging-logs/2026-04-02/worker.gz :warning:

rachel: thanks. did you grab a redacted copy? we need the key id to revoke immediately if it's a real key.

emily: redacted snippet posted to INC-2026-095. snippet shows email staging-batch@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com and a `private_key_id` of abc123def456. no other envs show errors yet.

tom: going to treat as confirmed exposure. I'll run revoke now and spin a new key. `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete abc123def456 --iam-account=staging-batch@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

tom: revoke succeeded. creating replacement with least privilege. uploading to Vault staging path: `vault kv put secret/staging/sa/staging-batch key=@new-key.json`

infra-bot: Deployment diff created: PR #1299 updates k8s secret reference and triggers rolling restart of staging batch workers.

emily: question: any archived S3 backups that might still have the full JSON? we should rewrap/re-encrypt and rekey if so. also search for similar pasted blobs in last 180 days.

rachel: yes — schedule a full archive grep. Tom, can you start rewrap on any matching objects using the current KMS key? guidance: `gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/current-key --plaintext-file=old.json --ciphertext-file=old.json.enc` then overwrite.

tom: starting rewrap job for bucket staging-backups (job job-2026-04-02-1). will report which objects updated.

sec-bot: Checklist appended to INC-2026-095: [revoke, replace, redeploy, vault-rotate, audit-on, grep-sweep, RBAC-lockdown].

emily: Vault check: search KV mounts for `staging-batch@redwood-inference` and rotate any entries. Also ensure audit logging enabled on the mount `secret/` and `kv-v2/` so we have read trace.

rachel: I enabled audit device for Vault mount at 4289990120. device path: /var/log/vault_audit/staging.log. attached commands in the ticket.

emily: RBAC: temporarily tighten SA key creation. proposal: remove roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin from devs group and add a just-in-time workflow for key creation via infra team for 48h. any objections?

tom: +1. I'll push an org policy: `gcloud organizations set-iam-policy ...` and create an emergency role backlog ticket.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-095 created and assigned to @rachel. severity: medium-low. SLA start: 4289990000.

sec-bot: For compliance: remember to archive original evidence (logs and S3 object) to an evidence bucket with restricted access and to record the exact gcloud/vault commands run.

emily: grep-sweep results (job-2026-04-02-1): found 3 additional occurrences in older rotated logs (2016-06-05, 2026-02-14, 2026-03-10). opening sub-tasks in the incident for each file.

rachel: ok we need to treat those as exposures too. Tom, rewrap and rotate keys referenced by those files. Emily, please notify partner teams for any cross-tenant visibility.

tom: rewrap done for objects found (job complete). rotated Vault entries and rotated any GCS tokens that depended on the exposed keys. PR #1301 documents the changes.

emily: noted a Vault path that had a copy of the JSON as a base64 blob: secret/staging/legacy/batch. rotated that secret and rekeyed. added to evidence.

rachel: post-incident tasks: 1) implement automated detector for JSON-looking SA blobs in logs (pattern: `"type":\s*"service_account"` + `"private_key_id"`), 2) add Vault mount audit enforcement, 3) RBAC change to require JIT approvals for SA key creation, 4) update runbook with rewrap procedure.

tom: I'll prototype the detector as a log processing rule and a Cloud Function that creates INC tickets on matches (TASK-2026-211).

emily: timeline: T0 revoke (done), T+30m rewrap sweep (done), T+2h rotate Vault entries (done), T+24h postmortem & remediation doc. Rachel will lead the postmortem.

rachel: thanks. schedule a 1hr postmortem at 4289993600 (calendar invite sent). bring evidence and command history.

emily: closing update for now. attaching all artifacts to INC-2026-095 and locking S3 objects to read-only for auditors. :lock:

sec-bot: Reminder: file the compliance report and mark the incident as audit-ready once postmortem doc uploaded.
